{{Quote|Do you have any idea what it's like, pretending to be a galactic mastermind? The performance pressure is huge!|The impersonator|<ref name="ch17">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=17}}</ref>}}
'''A man''' was forced to impersonate [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] by [[Z0-0M]], being the fifty-first and final person to play the role after the real Shroud's death.

==Biography==
[[The Shroud (Human)|The Shroud]] was a legendary freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who remained unaligned throughout the [[Galactic War]] and instead build a [[The Shroud's syndicate|spy syndicate]] of his own. However, at some point the Shroud was betrayed and killed by a [[IR-9X Replicator Droid|replicator droid]] in his service, [[Z0-0M]], who took over his identity and organization. Although her holographic disguise let her impersonate anyone, Z0-0M never put herself at risk and used actors as expendable decoys. The last man to play role was the fifty-first person to do so, having been put through hours of agonizing facial reconstruction that gave him the appearance of the original Shroud but numbed the feeling of his own face. He was forced to maintain the act at all times, even at Z0-0M's base at [[The Coil (Obus VI)|the Coil]], where he was given voice and acting lessons to play the role to perfection. His Cyborg Construct contained an explosive device that his master could detonate at any moment.

[[File:The_Shroud_impersonator_on_Odessen.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The impersonator is surprised to see his master on Odessen.]]
In [[3630 BBY]] Z0-0M initiated her plan to destroy the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] waging a war against the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. The impersonator infiltrated the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]] and placed multiple [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] in key locations. At the same time, Alliance [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[HK-55]] was captured and taken to the Coil, where Z0-0M created a copy of him and prepared the erase the original's memories. However, an accident caused the electrical surge to wipe Z0-0M's memories instead, causing the ruthless spymaster to develop a new personality and continue to experience periodic memory resets. Z0-0M freed HK-55 and returned with him to Alliance base just as the impersonator was finishing his sabotage activities. Believing the man to be the real Shroud, HK-55 held him at gunpoint, only for the actor to cave in and expose his master as the true mastermind. Although lacking evidence, he layed out all the ways in which Z0-0M prepared him as a decoy, causing her new personality to recognize the truth. HK-55 then knocked out the impersonator for colluding with the real Shroud to destroy the Alliance base, so that he could be handed over to his [[Alliance Commander|master]] for interrogation.<ref name="ch17" />
